## Fibonacci Sequence

A classic recursive implementation with memoization:

```{python}
def fibonacci(n, memo={}):
    """Return the nth Fibonacci number using memoization."""
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    
    memo[n] = fibonacci(n - 1, memo) + fibonacci(n - 2, memo)
    return memo[n]

# First 15 Fibonacci numbers
sequence = [fibonacci(i) for i in range(15)]
print("Fibonacci sequence:")
print(sequence)
```

## Prime Number Sieve

The Sieve of Eratosthenes finds all primes up to a given limit:
  
```{r}
sieve_of_eratosthenes <- function(n) {
  if (n < 2) return(integer(0))
  
  is_prime <- rep(TRUE, n)
  is_prime[1] <- FALSE
  
  for (i in 2:floor(sqrt(n))) {
    if (is_prime[i]) {
      is_prime[seq(i*i, n, by = i)] <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  which(is_prime)
}

primes <- sieve_of_eratosthenes(50)
cat("Primes up to 50:\n")
print(primes)
```
